name: Biren BR100 / BR104 spec reference (compiled from Biren disclosures)
notes: BR104 is the single-die cut of BR100: 32 GB HBM2e, 819 GB/s. Biren's own BR100 disclosure was 64 GB / 2.3 TB/s for the dual-die part, so half-capacity/half-bandwidth is internally consistent. Biren no longer serves a public BR104 datasheet page (JS-rendered site).
